topic: The all-integer largest-coefficient entropy limit for toroidal king graphs
title: Weighted toroidal extensions of Liang (2025): OEIS A394697, history revision 21, 6 May 2026 conjecture

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Extending Liang's (2025) free-board peak-entropy argument, we prove Kotěšovec's conjecture in OEIS A394697, history revision 21 (6 May 2026; entry snapshot revision 24): the largest coefficient of the n-by-n toroidal king independence polynomial has n²th root tending to A247413 through all integers n >= 3. The same comparison gives fixed-positive-activity entropy on arbitrary growing rectangles with free, cylindrical or toroidal boundaries, explicit boundary-to-area error bounds, and equal entropy for marked-count moments. Scalar log-concavity fails infinitely often; the even maximum-packing formula and its limiting density are reproved.
summary: Weighted rectangular and marked-count extensions of the toroidal peak-entropy limit, with explicit error bounds, precise prior attribution, packing consequences, and exact finite checks.

posing_source.locator: Conjecture comment added by Vaclav Kotesovec in history revision 21 on 6 May 2026; retained in entry snapshot revision 24

coverage.rectangular_limits_and_error: Written proof, Corollary 4, arbitrary aspect ratios with both sides tending to infinity
coverage.marked_count_moments: Written proof, Corollary 5, fixed activity z > 0 and fixed real power p >= 0; extending Liang (2025), Proposition 4.1
coverage.scalar_log_concavity: Refuted by the explicit n = 4 counterexample; infinitely many failures proved in Proposition 7
coverage.entropy_monotonicity: Listed source values increase for 3 <= n <= 21; universal monotonicity is not asserted in the source and is not covered
coverage.maximum_cardinality_A189889: Corollary 6 reproves the even branch and limiting density of the previously recorded formula; exact odd branch is not covered
coverage.finite_coefficients: verify.py and checks.json, 3 <= n <= 8; independent vertex recurrence at n = 3, 4
coverage.rectangular_finite_checks: sibling_checks.py and sibling-checks.json; width 3,...,6 and height 3,...,8, activities 1/2,1,2 and moment powers 0,1,2,3
